messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: merge error
parts:
You may see something like this if you try to pull

goodrich@CYBERPOWERPC:/opt/stan$ git pull
remote: Counting objects: 121, done.
remote: Finding sources: 100% (121/121), done.
remote: Total 121 (delta 49)
Receiving objects: 100% (121/121), 2.38 MiB | 1.00 MiB/s, done.
Resolving deltas: 100% (49/49), done.
From https://code.google.com/p/stan
   2d5ac18..d1b62f1  master     -> origin/master
error: The following untracked working tree files would be overwritten by merge:
        src/test/gm/model_specs/function_signatures
Please move or remove them before you can merge.
Aborting
goodrich@CYBERPOWERPC:/opt/stan$

I mv'ed that file and pulled again, which seems to work. But src/test/gm/model_specs/function_signatures is binary; is that supposed to be the case?

Ben
